variants.user_notes: Programming through the USB bootloader needs the board in its bootloader (DFU) mode; on many boards, hold its button while plugging it in. Its USB filter also matches the Soan-Papdi-Mini.

source.ref: The maker's pin diagram, https://soanpapdi.org/downloads/Soan-Papdi-Pin-Diagram.pdf, and its pin file in Icestudio (FPGAwars/icestudio, app/resources/boards/Soan-Papdi/pinout.pcf, by the board's makers, December 2025).
The maker's pin diagram and Icestudio pin file (pins), and https://soanpapdi.org/docs/hardware-overview/ (D7-D0, active high).
The maker's pin diagram and Icestudio pin file (S0-S3 on 39, 40, 41, 47), and https://soanpapdi.org/docs/hardware-overview/ (four white status LEDs S3-S0, active low).

ai_hints: S0 to S2 are wired to the FPGA's RGB LED driver pads (RGB0 to RGB2).
Drive S0 to S2 through SB_RGBA_DRV, the iCE40 UltraPlus's RGB LED driver cell (sink only).
